product_name: Noise ColorFit Pulse 2 Max 1.85" Display Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch (Jet Black)
reviews: [★5] Massive and crisp screen - The 1.85-inch display is large, legible, and easy to read text messages even for elderly parents.
[★5] Crisp Bluetooth calling - The onboard speaker is clear enough for answering calls while driving or busy cooking in the kitchen.
[★5] Stylish square watch face - Looks like an expensive smartwatch from a distance and the silicone strap feels soft on the wrist.
[★5] Good watch face selection - NoiseFit app has dozens of cloud watch faces with modern digital and analog themes.
[★5] Fast Bluetooth pairing - Connected to my OnePlus phone within seconds without needing multiple resets.
[★5] Convenient quick reply - Lets you send canned quick SMS replies to incoming calls without taking phone out of pocket.
[★5] Great gift under 1500 - Looks very premium in retail packaging and makes for a budget-friendly gift for friends.
[★5] Smooth touch response - Scrolling through menus and widget cards feels relatively fluid without noticeable lag.
[★4] Decent battery with calling off - Lasts around 4 to 5 days if you keep Bluetooth calling disabled and brightness at 50%.
[★4] Bright outdoor visibility - 550 nits peak brightness makes viewing notifications in sunlight reasonably clear.
[★4] Comfortable lightweight strap - Can wear it throughout the day without skin sweating or redness under the band.
[★4] Good stopwatch and timer - Useful for tracking gym rest sets and cooking countdowns with audible vibration alerts.
[★4] Functional music controller - Controls Spotify playback smoothly from wrist with next, previous, and pause buttons.
[★4] Decent for basic notifications - WhatsApp, Instagram, and SMS alerts pop up reliably without dropping connection often.
[★4] Value for money entry watch - At 1499 rupees you cannot expect Apple Watch accuracy, but it handles basics well.
[★3] Mediocre battery life with BT calling - Battery drains in less than 36 hours when Bluetooth calling feature is active.
[★3] Step counter overcounts heavily - Added 1,800 steps while I was just riding my motorcycle for 40 minutes on bumpy roads.
[★3] Annoying ads in companion app - The NoiseFit mobile app frequently pushes promotional banners and banner ads.
[★3] Plastic body prone to scratches - The faux metallic painted plastic bezel got scuffed after brushing against a door frame.
[★3] Sleep tracking is unreliable - Logs me as having deep sleep even when I woke up twice at night to drink water.
[★3] Average speaker volume outdoors - Hard to hear caller voice in busy street traffic without holding the watch close to ear.
[★2] Highly inaccurate heart rate sensor - Spikes to 145 bpm while sitting completely relaxed on the sofa. Do not trust for medical health monitoring.
[★2] Frequent Bluetooth disconnections - Randomly disconnects from Samsung phone requiring opening app manually to reconnect.
[★2] SpO2 readings are fabricated - Shows 98% oxygen saturation even when placed on a table roll of paper towel. Pure gimmick.
[★2] Clunky proprietary magnetic charger - The 2-pin charging puck falls off very easily if the cable is bumped slightly.
[★2] Screen bezel is deceptively thick - Real viewable screen area has thick black borders that were disguised in marketing renders.
[★2] Notification font is tiny and ugly - Long WhatsApp messages look pixelated with awkward word-wrapping and missing emoji support.
[★1] Stopped charging after 6 weeks - Watch died completely and refuses to turn on or take charge. Customer service is unhelpful.
[★1] Sensor glass fogged up from hand wash - IP68 rating claim is false; water vapor leaked inside optical sensor after a quick tap wash.
[★1] Vibration motor is weak and buzzy - Missed several important alarms because the vibration is too feeble to wake a heavy sleeper.
[★1] App sync failures on iOS - iPhone companion app constantly logs out and loses historic step and sleep statistics.
[★1] Terrible warranty support - Raised ticket for replacement and was asked to courier unit at own cost with 3 weeks turnaround.
